name: Pixie

actions.name: Pixie Dust
actions.effect: Sprinkles enchanted dust on a target. Target must pass WILL save or fall asleep for 1d4 rounds. Any damage wakes the target.

actions.name: Illusory Swarm
actions.effect: Creates illusory duplicates that swarm the target, causing confusion. Target has disadvantage on their next attack.

actions.name: Shrink
actions.effect: Shrinks one target to Tiny size for 1d4 rounds. Target's physical damage is halved. WILL save negates.

reactions.name: Greater Invisibility
reactions.effect: When targeted by an attack, the Pixie turns invisible until the end of its next turn. Attacking breaks the invisibility.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The Pixie can fly and does not provoke reactions when leaving an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Naturally Invisible
traits.desc: The Pixie can turn invisible at will as a free action at the end of its turn if it did not attack.

lore: Pixies are mischievous tiny fey who delight in pranks and trickery. They inhabit enchanted glades and fairy rings, using their innate magic to confound and bewilder intruders into their domain.
